# Safely Secured Homes - Full AI Context

Safely Secured Homes helps families in Luzon improve home safety with CCTV installation planning, smart-home security setup, and practical guidance that balances protection and comfort.

## Service Region
- Luzon
- Priority cluster: NCR + CALABARZON
- High-priority service areas: Metro Manila, Laguna, Quezon, Cavite, Rizal, Batangas

## What the Site Covers
- Home security strategy for families
- CCTV camera placement and blind-spot reduction
- Lighting and alerting best practices
- Weekly security routines and maintenance guidance
- Consultation-driven implementation paths
